w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.y.mean())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
gs={g:d for g,d in w.groupby('genre')}
for i in range(1000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([d.sample(len(d),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for d in gs.values()])))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))

print(pd.crosstab(w.late,w.date_confidence,normalize='index'));print(pd.crosstab(w.late,w.origin,normalize='index'));print(pd.crosstab(w.late,w.genre,normalize='index').round(2))
print(w.groupby('late').n_editions.mean())
w['ap']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count');print(w.groupby('late').ap.mean())
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
for o in w.origin.unique(): print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
m=smf.ols('y~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(ap)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]});print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
